title: DEERS Eligibility for the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
Eligibility for the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** rests on DEERS. The purchaser's DEERS beneficiary category, age, marital and coverage-eligibility facts meet the plan's requirements on the coverage effective date. This condition governs both recording a purchase and activating it, and it is read from the purchaser's DEERS profile - beneficiary category, date of birth, residence service area and sponsor - for the purchaser named on the purchase.

## Who may buy each plan

- **TRICARE Reserve Select** may be bought only by a member of the Selected Reserve who is not on active duty orders and is not eligible for the Federal Employees Health Benefits program.
- **TRICARE Retired Reserve** may be bought only by a member of the Retired Reserve who is qualified for non-regular retirement and has not reached the tier's age limit.
- **TRICARE Young Adult** may be bought only by an unmarried adult child of an eligible sponsor who has aged out of dependent eligibility (the tier's youngest purchase age, or its youngest purchase age for a full-time student), is under the tier's age limit and is not eligible for employer-sponsored coverage through their own job; **TRICARE Young Adult Prime** additionally requires residence in a Prime Service Area.

The age limits and youngest purchase ages are the figures each tier lists in its purchaser and coverage-end terms.

## When coverage ends

Coverage ends under the tier's coverage-end rule at the age limit; at the end of the day before an activation for more than 30 days starts (the family then moves to active duty family coverage); on marriage or on gaining employer-coverage eligibility for a young adult; and on loss of Selected or Retired Reserve status.

## Effect on the plan record

| Situation | Effect |
|---|---|
| A purchase is applied for and DEERS shows the purchaser eligible on the coverage effective date | the purchase may be processed and activated (with the purchase window met and the initial premium payment posted) |
| A purchase is applied for and the purchaser is not eligible for the plan | the purchase is rejected and coverage never starts |
| An active plan and DEERS no longer shows the purchaser eligible | the plan ends for ineligibility, on the last day of eligibility under the plan's rules |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- A Selected Reserve member eligible for FEHB applies for TRICARE Reserve Select: the purchaser is not eligible for the plan.
- A young adult who tells the representative they are unmarried while DEERS records a marriage: the DEERS facts decide.
- A young adult dependent living outside a Prime Service Area may meet the TRICARE Young Adult Select requirements but not those of TRICARE Young Adult Prime.
